name: yt-video
description: Search and watch YouTube videos for Spotify songs without cookies or tracking.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions yt-video.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions yt-video.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/yt-video.js" && spicetify config extensions yt-video.js- && spicetify apply
